commit_message: GATE-04: discovery and topology hints — bounded propagation + separate sequence floor
scope_completed: RemoteNodeHint type (reference/topology/remote-node-hint.ts — existing, with __brand phantom type)
Signed propagation message (createRemoteNodeHint + verifyRemoteNodeHint with reporter Ed25519 signature)
Separate propagation sequence floor (HintPropagationStore — distinct from advertisement sequence floor)
Bounded horizon (hopCount ≤ MAX_HINT_HOPS=3, forwardHint drops at max)
Replay protection (nonce uniqueness per reporter in HintPropagationStore)
forwardHint() with hopCount increment + re-signing + horizon drop
PROMOTE_HINT_TO_RECORD_FORBIDDEN architecture guard (existing, verified by test #2)
12 unit tests covering all bounds + guards
protocol_adr_references: ADR-0013 (three-layer separation — hint store is in reference/, DB-free)
known_limitations: Three-node real-process propagation test (integration) is deferred to a follow-up. The unit tests prove the protocol-core correctness; the integration test will exercise the mini-services once they support hint propagation.
The hint propagation store is in-memory only. A production implementation would need persistent storage for the propagation sequence floor (similar to the advertisement sequence floor).
The forwardHint function replaces the reporter with the forwarder. A future extension could preserve the full provenance chain (list of forwarders) for auditability.
